Pathweft's eBook preview (Preview/Ebook) adapts calibre's MOBI/KF8 reading (PalmDB and MOBI/EXTH headers,
PalmDOC and HUFF/CDIC decompression, trailing entries, INDX/TAGX/CNCX indexes, KF8 skeleton and fragment
assembly, NCX, guide TOC). EPUB and FB2 reading is Pathweft code. The original files it was
adapted from are under original/ with their SHA-256 in source-manifest.json. calibre itself does not ship
or run with Pathweft. Pathweft as a whole is GPL-3.0-or-later.
